reviews.comment: Was caring and tried to make the class helpful, but didn't have an engaging presence and the work was all kind of a blow off. There wasn't a ton to do and it wasn't hard, you just had to get it in. To be fair, it's Hullaballoo U so maybe she's different in other classes.

I wouldn't recommend this class. Attendance is absolutely mandatory, and her grading is just so strange and so difficult. Some of the activities are fun, but your entire grade pretty much rests on exams and one group project (pick the wrong people the first week of class, you're doomed). She is a nice lady, but this class isn't worth the stress.

A frustrating class and professor. Vague expectations and she'll grade you harshly for not magically understanding what she wants from you. By the end of the semester, she gave up on even making slides for our class, and just made all of the students make the slides for her. Would not recommend it.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Tough grader
